title: Measurements
description: Measurements of one variant. Numbers only; the unit is part of the key (cm, kg, l, inch). Only the measurements the brand stated are present; null instead of an empty object. How to measure: docs/protocol.md#measurements.

height_cm.description: Vertical, the article standing in normal use. Luggage: outer dimension including wheels, handles and feet. Bags: the body without handles and strap.

width_cm.description: Left to right, seen from the front. Luggage: outer dimension including wheels, handles and feet. Bags: the body.

depth_cm.description: Front to back. Luggage: outer dimension including wheels, handles and feet. Bags: the body.

weight_kg.description: Weight of the article itself, without packaging.

volume_expanded_l.description: Volume in litres when expanded (luggage and bags with an expansion zip).

handle_drop_cm.description: Bags: from the top of the handle to the top of the body, handle held upright.

strap_length_cm.description: Bags: length of the shoulder strap, shortest and longest setting (equal when not adjustable).

laptop_max_inch.description: Largest laptop (screen diagonal in inches) the laptop compartment takes.

heel_height_cm.description: Footwear: height of the heel at the back, measured from the floor.

shaft_height_cm.description: Footwear (boots): height of the shaft, from the top of the insole at the heel to the top of the shaft.

inseam_cm.description: Trousers: inside leg length, from the crotch seam to the hem.
